zht..x: 這個冬天孩子病了一場又一場，一直請假。

opts.do: spend('f_braces', .06 * base, 'trk.f_braces'); happy -= 1; if (roll('f_braces') < .2) spend('f_braces', .04 * base, 'trk.f_braces')

en..x: The dentist says your child needs braces.
en..abroad.h: Happiness −1. About one in five needs extra work later.
en..wait.h: Your child is self-conscious about their smile.

zh..x: 牙医说孩子要戴牙套矫正。
zh..abroad.h: 幸福感 −1。大约五个有一个之后要再补做。
zh..wait.h: 孩子会在意自己的笑容。

zht..x: 牙醫說孩子要戴牙套矯正。
zht..abroad.h: 幸福感 −1。大約五個有一個之後要再補做。
zht..wait.h: 孩子會在意自己的笑容。

en..x: Your teenager’s class is going abroad for a week, and they really want to go.
en..half: Pay half; they earn the rest
en..half.h: They learn the value of money.
en..no.h: Your teenager is upset with you.

zh..x: 孩子的班级要出国一星期，他们非常想去。
zh..half: 你出一半，其余他们自己赚

zht..x: 孩子的班級要出國一星期，他們非常想去。
zht..half: 你出一半，其餘他們自己賺

en..x: Your child says everyone in their class has a phone.
en..wait.h: Your child sulks for a while.

zh..x: 孩子说全班都有手机了。

zht..x: 孩子說全班都有手機了。

en..x: It is ten years since you married {p}.
en..trip: A trip away, just the two of you

zh..x: 你和{p}结婚十年了。

zht..x: 你和{p}結婚十年了。

opts.do: T('f_ptstudy', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.f_ptstudy')}); rec('f_ptstudy', .12 * base, 2); pt.q = pt.q * 1.15

en..x: {p} wants to go back to study for two years and change career.
en..yes.s: About {a} a year for two years in fees and lost income.
en..yes.h: Their pay afterwards is about 15% higher.

zh..x: {p}想回学校读两年书，换个职业。
zh..yes.s: 两年里每年大约{a}的学费和少掉的收入。
zh..yes.h: 读完后他们的工资大约高15%。

zht..x: {p}想回學校讀兩年書，換個職業。
zht..yes.s: 兩年裡每年大約{a}的學費和少掉的收入。
zht..yes.h: 讀完後他們的薪水大約高15%。

opts.do: pay(.1 * base); const tq = T('f_parmed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.f_parmed')}); tq.v -= .1 * base
pay(.05 * base); const tq = T('f_parmed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.f_parmed')}); tq.v -= .05 * base

en..x: {p} needs an operation, and the bill is {a}. They can’t pay it.
en..half: Pay half; siblings share the rest

zh..x: {p}要动手术，医药费{a}，他们付不起。
zh..half: 付一半，其余兄弟姐妹分摊

zht..x: {p}要動手術，醫藥費{a}，他們付不起。
zht..half: 付一半，其餘兄弟姊妹分攤

en..x: {p} has lost their flat and asks to move back home for a while.
en..rent: Yes, but they pay some rent
en..free.s: About {a} a year in food and bills.

zh..x: {p}租的房子没了，想搬回家住一阵子。

zht..x: {p}租的房子沒了，想搬回家住一陣子。

opts.do: T('m_boom', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.m_boom')}); rec('m_boom', .03 * base, 3); happy -= 1

en..x: Three years on, {p} is still in their old room and shows no sign of leaving.
en..help: Help with a deposit on a flat
en..stay.s: About {a} a year in food and bills.

zh..x: 三年过去了，{p}还住在原来的房间，完全没有要搬的意思。

zht..x: 三年過去了，{p}還住在原來的房間，完全沒有要搬的意思。

opts.do: famSpent += .5; cash += a; const tq = T('m_early', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.m_early')}); tq.v += a

en..x: {p} are selling the family home and want to give each child {a} now, rather than later.
en..take.h: It comes out of what they would leave you later.
en..keep: Tell them to keep it for themselves

zh..x: {p}要卖掉老家，想现在就给每个孩子{a}，不用等以后。
zh..take.h: 这笔钱会从他们以后留给你的遗产里扣掉。

zht..x: {p}要賣掉老家，想現在就給每個孩子{a}，不用等以後。
zht..take.h: 這筆錢會從他們以後留給你的遺產裡扣掉。

en..x: You wake up one morning wondering where the years went, and wanting something new.
en..car.h: Happiness +4 for a while; you get used to spending more.
en..bike.h: Happiness +3. Motorbikes are far riskier than cars.
en..trip: A long trip on your own

zh..x: 某天早上醒来，你想着这些年都去哪了，想来点新鲜的。
zh..car.h: 幸福感 +4 一阵子；也会习惯花更多钱。
zh..bike.h: 幸福感 +3。摩托车比汽车危险得多。

zht..x: 某天早上醒來，你想著這些年都去哪了，想來點新鮮的。
zht..car.h: 幸福感 +4 一陣子；也會習慣花更多錢。
zht..bike.h: 幸福感 +3。重機比汽車危險得多。

opts.do: cash += .06 * base; const tq = T('m_bikeS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.m_bikeS')}); tq.v += .06 * base; happy -= 1
happy += 1; if (roll('m_bike2') < .15) { health -= 8; pay(.05 * base); log(M('log.m_bike2'), 'bad') }

en..x: A car pulls out in front of you on your motorbike. You stop with centimetres to spare.
en..ride.h: Happiness +1. Riders your age have about one serious accident in seven.
en.log.m_bike2: You came off your motorbike and spent weeks in hospital.

zh..x: 你骑摩托车时，一辆车突然切出来，你在几公分前停住了。
zh..ride.h: 幸福感 +1。你这个年纪的骑士大约七个就有一个会出严重车祸。
zh.log.m_bike2: 你骑摩托车出了事，住院好几个星期。

zht..x: 你騎重機時，一台車突然切出來，你在幾公分前停住了。
zht..ride.h: 幸福感 +1。你這個年紀的騎士大約七個就有一個會出嚴重車禍。
zht.log.m_bike2: 你騎重機出了事，住院好幾個星期。

en..x: {p} has a long illness ahead, with treatment for months.
en..hours: Cut your hours to care for them
en..hours.s: 60% of your pay for two years.
en..paid.s: About {a} a year for two years.
en..they: They manage with friends and family
en.trk.m_carePaid: Care at home for your partner

zh..x: {p}得了一场要治疗好几个月的病。

zht..x: {p}得了一場要治療好幾個月的病。

en..x: {p}’s treatment is over and they are much better. What now for their work?
en..stop.h: Their pay is replaced by a small pension.

zh..x: {p}治疗结束，好多了。接下来工作怎么办？
zh..part.h: 他们的收入降到大约六成。
zh..stop.h: 他们的收入只剩一点退休金。

zht..x: {p}治療結束，好多了。接下來工作怎麼辦？
zht..part.h: 他們的收入降到大約六成。
zht..stop.h: 他們的收入只剩一點退休金。

opts.do: spend('m_hobby', .05 * base, 'trk.m_hobby'); T('m_hobbyR', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.m_hobby')}); rec('m_hobbyR', .02 * base, 10, .2); happy += 3

en..x: The children have all left home. The house is quiet, and there is money that used to go on them.
en..trip: The trip you always promised yourselves
en..hobby.s: About {a} to start and {b} a year.
en..hobby.h: Happiness +3; Health a little better each year.

zh..x: 孩子都离家了。家里很安静，以前花在他们身上的钱也省下来了。
zh..trip: 去那趟一直想去的旅行
zh..hobby.h: 幸福感 +3；健康每年好一点。

zht..x: 孩子都離家了。家裡很安靜，以前花在他們身上的錢也省下來了。
zht..trip: 去那趟一直想去的旅行
zht..hobby.h: 幸福感 +3；健康每年好一點。

later.m_sibloan: if (roll('m_sibloan') < .5) { cash += x.a; log(M('log.m_sibloanOk', {a: MN(x.a)}), 'good') } else log(M('log.m_sibloanNo', {a: MN(x.a)}), '')

en..x: {p} has run up debts and asks you for {a} to clear the worst of them.
en..lend.h: About half of family loans like this are paid back.
en.log.m_sibloanOk: Your sibling paid back the {a} you lent them.
en.log.m_sibloanNo: Your sibling never paid back the {a}.

zh..x: {p}欠了债，想跟你拿{a}先还掉最急的部分。
zh..lend.h: 这种借给家人的钱，大约一半会还。
zh..no.s: 接下来几个月关系很冷。

zht..x: {p}欠了債，想跟你拿{a}先還掉最急的部分。
zht..lend.h: 這種借給家人的錢，大約一半會還。
zht..no.s: 接下來幾個月關係很冷。

en..x: {p} turns 80 soon. The family talks about a holiday together to celebrate.
en..share: Split the cost with your siblings
en.trk.m_80: A family trip for an 80th birthday

zh..x: {p}快八十岁了。家里在讨论一起去旅行庆祝。

zht..x: {p}快八十歲了。家裡在討論一起去旅行慶祝。

zh..x: 孩子考到驾照了，上班需要一辆车。

zht..x: 孩子考到駕照了，上班需要一台車。

en..no: Tell them to get started instead
